gui.guhs.vadskracht.stil.te_zwaar: Too heavy: it's %s chonk power short, so everything stands still. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.vadskracht.stil.geen_bron: No chonk power: there's no guh running anywhere. Put a tame guh in a Guh Wheel!
gui.guhs.vadskracht.stil.te_groot: Too big: more than %s blocks joined together, that makes a guh dizzy. Everything stands still.
gui.guhs.vadskracht.op_batterij: The battery tops up %s chonk power: %s left
gui.guhs.vadskracht.telt_niet_mee: Doesn't count: at most %s %s per setup
gui.guhs.vadskracht.guhrad.leeg: No guh is running in this wheel
gui.guhs.vadskracht.guhrad.blij: A happy little guh: it runs extra fast, nyeg!
block.guhs.guh_wheel.lore: Put a tame guh inside: it runs up chonk power for your guh machines. A happy little guh runs extra fast, and it never gets tired.
block.guhs.guh_wire.lore: Carries chonk power from your Guh Wheel to your guh machines. Everything hooked up to it is one setup together: look at it and you'll read how much chonk power it uses.
gui.guhs.vadskracht.commando.niets: There is no chonk power setup here
gui.guhs.vadskracht.commando.net: Status %s: %s blocks, %s nodes (%s setups in this world)
advancements.guhs.techniek.bank_gehapt.d: Feed a Nom Hatch something: it lands in your Bank Guh right away, however far off it stands
advancements.guhs.techniek.bank_opgevoer: Give your Bank Guh the Bottomless Nibble Belly: now it holds endless amounts of everything. Wahoog!
block.guhs.bank_guh.opgevoerd: With Bottomless Nibble Belly: it holds endless amounts of everything. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.bank.cap: At most %s of each kind. Full is full, nyeg!
gui.guhs.bank.opgevoerd: Bottomless Nibble Belly: it holds endless amounts of everything!
gui.guhs.bank.vol: Full! No more %s fits in (at most %s)
gui.guhs.bank.stored.vol: Full! No more of this fits in, nyeg
gui.guhs.bank.stored.te_veel: More than %s, from the old days. Taking out is always fine, putting in not just now
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.lore: Click your Bank Guh with it: then its tummy no longer holds at most %s of each kind, but endless amounts
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.lore.blijft: It stays with that Bank Guh forever, even if you pick it up and put it down somewhere else
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.lore.uit: Careful: after that, hoppers and tubes may take things out of it too
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.gelukt: Gulp! Your Bank Guh's tummy is now bottomless. Wahoog!
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.uit: Careful: hoppers, Direction Pieces and Delivery Guhlings may now take things out of this Bank Guh too, and they take everything. Only a Filter Piece with 'leave behind' keeps something back for you.
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.trechter: There's a hopper hanging under this Bank Guh: it's slurping it completely empty now, nyeg!
item.guhs.bank_upgrade.al: This Bank Guh already has a Bottomless Nibble Belly. Two tummies is too chonky, nyeg
item.guhs.bank_sleutel.lore: First click your Bank Guh, then every Nom Hatch that should nom for it. The key never runs out
item.guhs.bank_sleutel.leeg: Doesn't know a Bank Guh yet
item.guhs.bank_sleutel.gebonden.plek: Knows the Bank Guh that stood at %s, %s, %s (%s)
item.guhs.bank_sleutel.onthouden: The key now knows the Bank Guh at %s, %s, %s. Click a Nom Hatch with it!
block.guhs.hapluikje.lore: Nom! Everything you pop in lands in your Bank Guh right away, however far off it stands. Link it with a Bank Key. It only noms: nothing ever comes out
block.guhs.hapluikje.lore.kracht: Needs %s chonk power. Without chonk power it takes a nap
block.guhs.hapluikje.slaapt: The Nom Hatch is taking a nap: it needs %s chonk power. Nyeg...
block.guhs.hapluikje.los: This Nom Hatch doesn't belong to any Bank Guh yet. With a Bank Key, first click your Bank Guh and then here
block.guhs.hapluikje.weg: This hatch's Bank Guh isn't standing anywhere. Put it back down and the hatch will nom again
block.guhs.hapluikje.klaar: This hatch noms for the Bank Guh at %s, %s, %s (%s). Go on, pop something in!
block.guhs.hapluikje.hap: Nom! %s× %s is in your Bank Guh
block.guhs.hapluikje.vol: Your Bank Guh is full of %s (%s/%s). The hatch is keeping its little mouth shut!
block.guhs.hapluikje.geleend: The Nom Hatch doesn't fancy borrowed things: those aren't yours, nyeg
block.guhs.hapluikje.sleutel_leeg: This Bank Key doesn't know a Bank Guh yet. Click your Bank Guh with it first
block.guhs.hapluikje.gekoppeld: Linked! This hatch now noms for the Bank Guh at %s, %s, %s (%s)
block.guhs.hapluikje.gekoppeld.weg: Linked! But that Bank Guh isn't standing anywhere right now: put it down and the hatch will nom
gui.guhs.bank.luikje.los: Not linked yet: click with a Bank Key
gui.guhs.bank.luikje.weg: Its Bank Guh isn't standing anywhere, so it won't nom
gui.guhs.bank.luikje.klaar: Noms for the Bank Guh at %s, %s, %s (%s)
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_bronnen_: Let a tame guh lie down on your Cuddle Generator. Nyeg, that's a comfy spot!
Dance Till the Lights Come On
Put a disc on your Disco Dynamo and let a guh dance up the chonk power
Keep a Sauce Blubby warm in a Blub Stove (it does love a cheese nibble)
A Star in a Little Cage
Place a Glowstar Core: 200 chonk power, forever
block.guhs.knuffelgenerator.lore: A big pink cushion of 2 by 2 blocks. Tame guhs within 8 blocks come and lie on it all by themselves, and every guh lying there cuddling gives 3 chonk power (at most 8 guhs: 24 chonk power). Turn off Chonk around and your guh stays put when you walk away. Guhs with a Guh House of their own are too busy with their chores.
block.guhs.disco_dynamo.lore: A dance floor of 3 by 3 blocks with a turntable. Put a music disc on it and tame guhs within 8 blocks come to dance: every dancer gives 5 chonk power (at most 4 guhs: 20 chonk power). Every disc has its own light show, and an empty hand takes the disc off again. Wahoog!
block.guhs.blubkacheltje.lore: Pop in a Sauce Blubby in a Jar and give it a cheese nibble now and then: it blubs up 6 chonk power. One nibble keeps it warm for 10 minutes. Sneak + empty hand: the blubby may come out again.
block.guhs.gloeisterkern.lore: The Burnt Mika's glowstar in a little cage of salt crystal: 200 chonk power, forever. It never runs out and wants no nibbles. Only one counts per setup.
block.guhs.knabbelbatterij.lore: Saves the chonk power your setup has left over, up to 18000 (about 30 minutes of one Guh Wheel), and tops up when your machines ask for a bit more. It keeps its charge when you break it and take it along.
gui.guhs.techbron.knuffel.leeg: No guh on the cushion yet: tame guhs within %s blocks come and lie down by themselves
gui.guhs.techbron.knuffel.guhs: %s/%s guhs are lying there cuddling, nyeg!
gui.guhs.techbron.disco.geen_plaat: No disc: put a music disc on the turntable
gui.guhs.techbron.disco.leeg: The floor is still empty: tame guhs within %s blocks come and dance by themselves
gui.guhs.techbron.disco.dansers: %s/%s guhs are dancing up the chonk power, wahoog!
gui.guhs.techbron.disco.zeldzaam: Rare disc: every dancer gives %s extra chonk power
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.leeg: No jar inside: pop in a Sauce Blubby in a Jar
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.trek: The Sauce Blubby is peckish: give it a cheese nibble, nyeg!
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.warm: The Sauce Blubby blubs nice and warm (%s/%s nibbles in the little tray)
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.bezet: A Sauce Blubby lives here already
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.erin: Blub! The Sauce Blubby is sitting pretty and toasty
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.erin_trek: Blub? The Sauce Blubby is peckish: give it a cheese nibble
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.vol: The little tray is full of nibbles
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.gevoerd: Munch munch! %s/%s nibbles in the little tray
gui.guhs.techbron.blub.voer_zonder_blubj: The nibble is ready and waiting. Now just a Sauce Blubby, nyeg
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.hard: The Baltoguh runs faster than anyone: a real sled guh
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.zweeft: Guhtwo doesn't run. He floats, and the wheel just spins along
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.dubbel: The 626-guh counts double: six pawsies run faster than four
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.sjouwt: Sam-guh lugs the whole wheel around, backpack and all
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.fladdert: Guhshi flutter-kicks the wheel round and round
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.tip: Tip: a guh that was just lying on a Cuddle Generator is happy, and runs faster
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.rent: Your guh is running: %s chonk power!
gui.guhs.techbron.guhrad.rent_blij: Your happy guh runs extra fast: %s chonk power, wahoog!
block.guhs.knabbelbuis.lore: A see-through tube where you can watch your things roll by. Sticks itself to chests, guh machines, the Bank Guh and the Nom Hatch. On its own it does nothing: add a Direction Piece, nyeg!
block.guhs.knabbelbuis_richting.lore: A piece of Nibble Tube with an arrow. Noms things out of whatever is behind it and sends them into the tube. Between two tubes it's one-way traffic. Sneak + click: turn it around. A redstone signal locks it.
block.guhs.knabbelbuis_filter.lore: A Direction Piece with a picky little guh inside: it only lets through what's on its list and noms in big bites. Whatever is behind it gets those things first: that's how you sort. Wants 2 chonk power.
block.guhs.opzuiger.lore: Slurps up every loose thing nearby. No more bending down, nice and chonky! Wants 3 chonk power.
block.guhs.voorraadmeter.lore: Counts what's in the chest, the machine or the Bank Guh behind it and gives a redstone signal when there's enough (or not enough). Wants 1 chonk power.
block.guhs.snuffelsensor.lore: A nose that smells who's nearby: guhs, Mikas or players. If it smells someone, it gives a redstone signal. Wants 1 chonk power.
block.guhs.guhklok.lore: Gives a little redstone tick every so often, or a signal as long as it's day (or night). Click to reset it. Wants 1 chonk power.
block.guhs.guhteller.lore: Counts the redstone ticks coming in at its back and gives a tick of its own every so many. Click to choose how far it counts. Wants 1 chonk power.
gui.guhs.techbuis.stand.op_slot: Locked: a redstone signal is coming in
gui.guhs.techbuis.stand.verstopt: Clogged: its things have nowhere to go, nyeg!
gui.guhs.techbuis.stand.geen_plek: This tube doesn't end anywhere that takes things
gui.guhs.techbuis.stand.onderweg: Sends things to %s place(s); %s are rolling through the tube right now
gui.guhs.techbuis.filter.alles: Lets everything through (the list is empty)
gui.guhs.techbuis.filter.bewaar: Leaves behind at least %s of each thing
gui.guhs.techbuis.meter.geen_kist: Sees nothing to count in: put its back against a chest, a machine or the Bank Guh
gui.guhs.techbuis.meter.minstens: Gives a signal at %s or more
gui.guhs.techbuis.meter.minder: Gives a signal at fewer than %s
gui.guhs.techbuis.klok.dag: Gives a signal as long as it's day
gui.guhs.techbuis.klok.nacht: Gives a signal as long as it's night
gui.guhs.techbuis.opzuiger.vol: Full up: nothing more fits in. Empty it with a Direction Piece!
gui.guhs.techbuis.scherm.filter.lijst.ui: Should the Filter Piece let through only the things in the slots, or everything except those? Click a slot with a thing to set it as an example (you keep it yourself).
gui.guhs.techbuis.scherm.meter.lijst.uit: Should the Stock Meter give a signal when there's at least this many, or when there's fewer? With no example in the slot it counts everything.
gui.guhs.techbuis.scherm.precies.uitleg: Very exact: a thing only counts if it is exactly the same as the example (name, enchantment, what's inside). Not so exact: the same kind is good enough.
gui.guhs.techbuis.scherm.getal.uitleg: Click: 1 more or less. With shift: 8. With ctrl: 64.
gui.guhs.techbuis.commando.geen_stuk: There's no Direction Piece or Filter Piece there
gui.guhs.techbuis.commando.plek: - %s at %s (side %s): %s blocks of tube, %s piece(s) on the way
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_buizen_b: Make a Nibble Tube: your things roll through it all by themselves
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_buizen_f: Make a Filter Piece and let it sort your things
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_buizen_o: Make a Slurper. No more bending down, nyeg
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_buizen_s: Make a Stock Meter, a Sniff Sensor, a Guh Clock or a Guh Counter
block.guhs.sauspomp.lore: Put it on top of a source of sauce or water: on 6 chonk power it slurps up a bucket every 2 seconds, into the Sauce Hose. The source never runs out. Nyeg!
block.guhs.sausslang.lore: A thin little hose for sauce. Lay it from your Sauce Pump to a Sauce Vat or a machine: it hooks itself up. At most 256 hoses in a row, after that the sauce can't be bothered anymore.
block.guhs.sausvat.lore: Holds 16 buckets of one sauce: cheese sauce, cheese frying sauce, water or milk. Tap some out with a bucket or pour one in. Machines slurp from it through a Sauce Hose. What's inside comes along when you pick up the vat.
block.guhs.brouwautomaat.lore: The Guh Brewing Cauldron that stirs itself, on 8 chonk power. A bucket of cheese sauce, one ingredient and 3 glass bottles in: 3 Guh Potions bubble out. No Grill Skewer Powder needed, chonk!
block.guhs.frituurautomaat.lore: The frying pan that fries by itself, in cheese frying sauce and on 8 chonk power. Nibbles in, fried nibbles out: one bucket of sauce is good for 100 of them. Wahoog!
block.guhs.grillkoolpers.lore: Two blocks tall. On 8 chonk power it presses a bucket of cheese frying sauce and a bucket of water together into a block of grill coal. No burnt pawsies.
gui.guhs.techsaus.wacht.vol: someone to empty it: it's full, nyeg!
gui.guhs.techsaus.wacht.bron: a source: put the pump on top of sauce or water
gui.guhs.techsaus.wacht.andere_saus: an empty tank: there's still %s in it
gui.guhs.techsaus.wacht.snack: cheese nibbles or a guhfish to fry
gui.guhs.techsaus.slang_te_lang: This hose is too long, nyeg: after %s hoses the sauce can't be bothered anymore
gui.guhs.techsaus.vol: That won't fit in anymore, nyeg
gui.guhs.techsaus.emmer_past_niet: That bucket doesn't fit here: wrong sauce, too full or too empty
gui.guhs.techsaus.vat.te_weinig: There isn't a whole bucket of %s in it yet
gui.guhs.techsaus.vat.geen_saus: That's not a sauce for a Sauce Vat
gui.guhs.techsaus.vat.andere_saus: There's %s in it already: one sauce per vat, nyeg
gui.guhs.techsaus.vat.vol: The Sauce Vat is full of %s
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_vloeisto: Put a Sauce Pump on a source and let it slurp up a whole bucket on chonk power
Tap sauce out of a Sauce Vat with a bucket
Let an Auto Brewer brew three Guh Potions for you
Let an Auto Fryer fry cheese nibbles for you
Under Pressure Everything Turns to Grill Coal
Press frying sauce and water together into a block of grill coal in the Grill Coal Press
